RandomForestTrainer

Random Forest Model training manager using Yggdrasil Decision Forests.

Module Contents

class src.RandomForestTrainer.RandomForestTrainer(interval: str, log_dir: str = './RFlog')

Random Forest Model training manager using Yggdrasil Decision Forests.

Supports hyperparameter tuning and TensorBoard logging for model evaluation.

src.RandomForestTrainer.train_with_hparams(X: numpy.ndarray, y: numpy.ndarray, X_val: numpy.ndarray = None, y_val: numpy.ndarray = None, X_test: numpy.ndarray = None, y_test: numpy.ndarray = None, epochs: int = 10, batch_size: int = 1, num_cats: int = 6, categories: list[str] = None) → None

Train model with hyperparameter tuning using manual search.

Parameters:

  • X (np.ndarray) – Training input features

  • y (np.ndarray) – Training target labels (one-hot encoded)

  • X_val (np.ndarray, optional) – Validation input features, defaults to None

  • y_val (np.ndarray, optional) – Validation target labels, defaults to None

  • X_test (np.ndarray, optional) – Test input features, defaults to None

  • y_test (np.ndarray, optional) – Test target labels, defaults to None

  • epochs (int, optional) – Number of training epochs, defaults to 10

  • batch_size (int, optional) – Batch size, defaults to 1

  • num_cats (int, optional) – Number of output categories, defaults to 6

  • categories (list[str], optional) – List of category names, defaults to None

  • X_val (np.ndarray) – Validation input features

  • y_val (np.ndarray) – Validation target labels
